name: Puni☆Fugo~
source:
Main character's parents go bankrupt leaving him a lot of debts. He decides to become a student of millionaire school and learn to gamble in order to cover his debts. Revenge for the enemy who pushed parents to such den of despair starts with a card game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母破产，给他留下大笔债务。他决定进入富豪学校学习赌博，用赢来的钱偿还欠债。从一场牌局开始，他将向那个把父母逼入绝境的仇敌展开复仇。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
